goal: Design and scaffold a landing page for the pixel-art Agent Hub

tasks.title: Architecture & tech stack decision
tasks.prompt: Propose a minimal tech stack and file structure for a single-page landing site (static, no backend). Output: a short markdown spec with file list and section layout.

tasks.title: Write landing page copy
tasks.prompt: Write concise landing page copy (hero headline, 3 feature blurbs, CTA) for 'Agent Hub' — a pixel-art multi-agent orchestration dashboard. Tone: playful Y2K retro. Output plain markdown.

tasks.title: Build index.html
tasks.prompt: Create a single self-contained index.html implementing the spec and copy from context. Pixel-art Y2K style via CSS only (no external assets). Write the file to disk as index.html and reply with a summary of what you built.

tasks.title: Review the deliverable
tasks.prompt: Review the upstream outputs: does the built page match the spec and copy? List any gaps as bullet points, then give a verdict line: PASS or FAIL with reason.
